title: How Learning One Hard Skill Slowly Makes a Godly Man Useful
caption:
Your 20s are where a man gets built. And one of the most underrated ways to get built is learning one hard, useful skill slowly.

Pick something people actually need. Be bad at it for a while. Practice in small reps when nobody's watching. Then give it away: fix the car, teach the younger guy, cook for the family that just had a baby.

"One who is faithful in a very little is also faithful in much." Luke 16:10

Comment the skill you're going to start learning.
